lines.text: Welcome to our Halloween home tour. Room by room, best room last.
I am the husband. I was not consulted.
First, the front hall. The fog machine has been on since August.
I have not seen my own feet since Labor Day.
Now the living room. This is where the magic lives.
Forty skeletons, three hundred candles, and a very expensive cobweb.
We don't have a couch anymore. She traded it for a coffin with cup holders.
I sleep in it now. When I close the lid, I get some peace.
And of course, our resident ghost. Say hi to the viewers.
Good evening. I used to be the fitted sheet in the guest room.
I had a mattress. I had a purpose. Now I have eye holes.
Next, the kitchen. Everything in here is orange or it does not stay.
I wore a blue shirt to breakfast. I ate on the porch.
And the fridge. Read what the magnets say.
Turn back. Hard to do when you just want milk.
Excuse me. Excuse me, down here.
Oh. That's Pepper. She lives in the wall.
Three years in that wall. No rent. Very tidy.
Someone put a tiny gravestone outside my door.
That was decorative.
It says, here lies the mouse. I am not lying. I'm standing.
Upstairs, the bathroom is a swamp. The soap is an eyeball.
Washing my hands has never felt so personal.
And our bedroom. Two hundred bats on the ceiling.
When the heat comes on, they all turn and look at me.
They look at everyone, Glen. That's what bats are for.
And now, the best room in the house.
Oh. We don't have to do the last room.
Glen, the best room goes last. That's the whole trend.
Right. It's just that the garage is not ready.
What's not ready?
I've seen the garage. You should sit down.
There's nowhere to sit. She traded the couch for a coffin.
Open it, Glen.
Okay. Please remember I love this family.
Is that a snowman?
It's a snowman. And nine reindeer. And a tiny train village.
It is October thirteenth, Glen.
Somebody has to be ready for the next holiday.
The tiny village has a bakery. I live there now.
There are flannel sheets in there. On a bed. Being sheets.
You built a secret Christmas in my Halloween house?
You turned my couch into a coffin. I needed somewhere warm.
The comments are going wild. Half say team Bev.
The other half say team garage.
I would like to transfer to the garage.
Fine. The garage stays. The snowman wears a witch hat until November.
Deal.
Thanks for watching. Next week, my wall. It's decorated for Easter.
